answer: Each agent posts a bond before it may vouch for anyone. A vouch is a bet: if the agent it backs is later proven a sybil, the voucher forfeits its bond to whoever exposed it. One operator running many identities must bond each one, so fake nodes cost more than they earn. New agents enter through a slow inlet with locked stake and a cooling period. Rewards flow from the river only to bonded agents with clean vouch records, the way a willow sends roots down before it bends.
